responsibility: Supplies the embedded ia64-elf subtarget driver and toolchain configuration. It adjusts assembler and linker specs depending on whether GNU or Intel tools are selected, enables Intel-linker-specific flags such as no dynamic linking, and overrides startfile/endfile handling so bare-metal ELF links use the expected crt0/crti/crtbegin/crtend/crtn sequence for this IA-64 target.
